entities.name: Heliocentrism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The astronomical model proposing that the Sun, not the Earth, is the center of the solar system. First articulated by Copernicus in 1543 and confirmed by Galileo's telescopic observations, it overthrew the ancient geocentric worldview and catalyzed the Scientific Revolution.
